notes.title: Early September Dev Update 🚩
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Architects![/p][p]We’ve been busy behind the scenes, and it’s time to share some exciting updates with you. 

[i]Under Par Golf Architect[/i] is moving steadily into its [b]beta phase[/b] as we get closer to release, and we’ve also kicked off the [b]porting process[/b] to bring the game to more platforms.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the things we’re most excited about is the [b]demo[/b], which will be available very soon. If you haven’t already, make sure to [b]wishlist the game[/b]—that way you’ll get notified the moment the demo goes live!
[/p][p]Also, keep an eye on the [b]upcoming PC showcases[/b]. You might just spot [i]Under Par Golf Architect[/i] there, along with a couple of brand-new features we haven’t revealed before.
[/p][p]Gamescom was a truly [b]productive milestone[/b] for us—full of hands-on feedback, conversations, and new connections. We hope to get all the things sorted and turn those [i]Under Par[/i] opportunities into reality! 🤞
In the meantime, you can check out this [b]preview from Gamescom[/b]: [/p][list][*][p][url="https://insider-gaming.com/under-par-golf-architect-hands-on-preview/"]https://insider-gaming.com/under-par-golf-architect-hands-on-preview/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]It’s a great hands-on impression of what we’ve been building.[/p][p]For our French-speaking community, you may want to read this as well: [/p][list][*][p][url="https://jv.jeuxonline.info/actualite/65415/gamescom-2025-under-golf-architect-tycoon-ancienne"]https://jv.jeuxonline.info/actualite/65415/gamescom-2025-under-golf-architect-tycoon-ancienne[/url]
[/p][/*][/list][p]Under Par was a show stopper at the italian booth 🤩[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/461897bea28b63e8c02ca1c23d5b1696c6e9c6ae.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We also want to give a huge shoutout to our [b]communities on [/b][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/underpargame/"]Reddit [/url][b]and [/b][url="https://discord.gg/6BwvsyWDBZ"]Discord[/url]. You’ve been sharing ideas, feedback, and feature suggestions—and while we can’t promise everything will make it into the game, please know we’re reading and discussing all of it. If you’d like to be part of shaping the future of [i]Under Par Golf Architect[/i], we’d love to see you there too!
[/p][p]Thanks again for all your support—it means the world to us. 
We can’t wait to share more and see the creative courses you’ll design when the demo drops!

[/p][p]– The Broken Arms Games Team[/p]

notes.title: A quick update
notes.notes:
Good Morning Golf Architects!

We are starting stress testing our hole design tool by trying to build some well known Golf Holes!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/pfwsfHvkpcw]Pebble beach Hole 18 video[/url]

Unfortunately we lost the save file after we made the video because we wanted to include the golfers playing it...

We also made our first public Hand On last week, getting ready for our the first closed beta (maybe in may)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/0c46aa7fe9a9b1354e5edbf81713cdd136ca8abf.jpg[/img]

As we start to get ready for some external testing follow us to stay updated!

Best

Yves
